set -euo pipefail

# Activate conda
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

# Defaults
DATA_PATH="data/v9_dpo_pairs.jsonl"
MODEL_NAME="/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/Qwen3-8B"
OUTPUT_BASE="outputs"
WANDB_PROJECT="etadn-dpo"

        --wandb_project) WANDB_PROJECT="$2"; shift 2 ;;

    --model_name "$MODEL_NAME" \
    --output_dir "$OUTPUT_BASE/etadn_s42" \
    --mode etadn \
    --seed 42 \
    --wandb_project "$WANDB_PROJECT" \

            --model_name "$MODEL_NAME" \
            --output_dir "$OUTPUT_BASE/sweep_g${GAMMA_TAG}" \
            --mode single_gamma \
            --gamma "$GAMMA" \
            --seed 42 \
            --wandb_project "$WANDB_PROJECT" \
            --wandb_run_name "sweep_g${GAMMA_TAG}" \
            --gpu 0 \
            2>&1 | tee "$LOG_DIR/sweep_g${GAMMA_TAG}.log"
        echo "[sweep-gpu1] Finished gamma=$GAMMA"
    done
) &
PID_SWEEP1=$!
